purpose: fix what counts as a deterministic match BEFORE either run exists, so no mismatch can be excused after the fact by adding an exclusion

EXCLUDED_AND_WHY.absolute paths: each run extracts to its own output directory by design
EXCLUDED_AND_WHY.anchor_commit: each run anchors in its own throwaway repo, so the commit id differs
EXCLUDED_AND_WHY.producer_code_commit: differs per scratch repo; the CODE HASHES it certifies are compared instead
EXCLUDED_AND_WHY.receipt_hash / anchor_hash: cover the excluded timestamps above; the freeze_sha256 and producer_code_hashes they carry ARE compared

SEPARATELY_COMPARED_BOUND_CONTENTS: anchor.producer_code_hashes (every bound source, by canonical path)
RULE: no field may be moved from COMPARED to EXCLUDED after a mismatch is observed. A mismatch in a compared field is a REPRODUCIBILITY FAILURE and is reported as one.
